annotation.title_clean: The impact of using exoskeletons on occupational safety and health
annotation.title_en: The impact of using exoskeletons on occupational safety and health
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Agency for Safety and Health at Work (EU-OSHA)
annotation.summary_en: Publication page for an EU-OSHA discussion paper on how workplace exoskeletons affect worker safety and health. It says exoskeletons may help prevent musculoskeletal disorders but also bring risks. It notes that their long-term health effects are uncertain and that a uniform certification is hard to create. It says workplace design should follow the hierarchy of prevention rather than rely on exoskeletons.
key_provisions_or_claims: Exoskeletons could help prevent work-related musculoskeletal disorders.
Their use in various fields may create new safety and health risks.
Their long-term health effects are uncertain, and more comprehensive studies are needed.
Creating a uniform certification for exoskeletons is difficult.
Workplace design should follow the hierarchy of prevention rather than rely on exoskeletons for ergonomics.
